name: agentic-icon-builder
description: Agentic Icon Builder for SVG-first logo and glyph workflows, previews, and exports.

scripts.preview: npm run ensure:deps && npm run build:specs && node scripts/node/serve-preview.mjs
scripts.workflow:logo: npm run build:specs && npm run generate:png && npm run capture
scripts.ui-theme:link-local: cd ../wintermuted-ui-theme && npm link && cd - && npm link @wintermuted/ui-theme
